title: Disable/Enable a Charging Location From RMS Charger Selection to Manually Charge a Low-Power AGV
summary: Use RMS Charger Selection to logically disable a specific charging location (by charger ID) so RMS will not route AGVs to it. Physically place a low-power AGV onto that disabled charger for a charging boost, then re-enable the charger so RMS/WCS can resume charging allocation from the charging queue.
when_to_use: When an AGV’s power is extremely low (e.g., stuck in an error state too long) and you need to manually place it onto a charger for a charging boost by preventing RMS from routing other AGVs to that charger.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the RMS Charger Selection disable/enable actions and verify the charger status changes as expected.
safety_notes: Disabling a charger is a logical allocation control (it does not “kill” the charger hardware).
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) with Charger Selection view

system_preconditions: The target charging station has a unique charger ID visible in RMS Charger Selection.

visual_references.description: RMS Charger Selection frame showing charger selection by charger ID and the concept of enabled/disabled charger status for logical allocation control.

steps.title: Open RMS Charger Selection view
steps.purpose: Access the charger list and charger details needed to disable/enable a specific charging location by charger ID.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), navigate to the Charger Selection view.
steps.expected_result: The Charger Selection view is open and shows charging stations with unique charger IDs available for selection.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see charger IDs in Charger Selection and select a charger to view its status (enabled vs disabled).
steps.failure_condition: Charger IDs or charger status (enabled/disabled) are not visible, or the Charger Selection view cannot be accessed.

actions.label: Navigate to Charger Selection
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the Charger Selection view.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Charger Selection: click charger ID to view charger status (enabled/disabled) and associated robot.

steps.title: Select the target charger by charger ID
steps.purpose: Identify the exact charging location to logically disable/enable.
steps.instruction: In Charger Selection, click/select the target charging station using its unique charger ID.
steps.expected_result: The selected charger’s details are displayed for the chosen charger ID.
steps.healthy_condition: The charger details panel updates to show the selected charger and its associated information (including which robot is on that charger).
steps.failure_condition: Selecting a charger does not update the charger details, or the wrong charger ID appears selected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Each charging station will have a unique ID; click on the charger ID to view charger status (enabled or disabled) and what robot is on that charger.

steps.title: Verify charger status is enabled or disabled
steps.purpose: Confirm the current logical allocation state before changing it.
steps.instruction: Check the selected charger’s status field/label to determine whether it is currently enabled or disabled.
steps.expected_result: The selected charger shows a status indicating enabled vs disabled.
steps.healthy_condition: The status clearly indicates whether the charger is enabled or disabled for allocation.
steps.failure_condition: The status does not show enabled/disabled, or the status is unclear/unresponsive.

actions.label: Check enabled/disabled status
actions.exact_action: you can see the status of the charger. Is that charger enabled or disabled

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: In Charger Selection, you can see the status of the charger: enabled or disabled.

steps.title: Disable the charger allocation (logical disable) for manual charging
steps.purpose: Prevent RMS from routing other AGVs to this charging location while you manually place the low-power AGV.
steps.instruction: If the charger is currently enabled and you need to manually charge the low-power AGV, click Disable for that charging location in the Charger Selection details panel.
steps.expected_result: The charger allocation is logically disabled (status changes to disabled).
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking Disable, the selected charger’s status indicates disabled (logical allocation unavailable).
steps.failure_condition: After clicking Disable, the charger status does not change to disabled.

actions.label: Disable charging location
actions.exact_action: click Disable for that charging location (logical disable)

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the charger status does not change to disabled after clicking Disable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “you'll see a disabled function… it doesn't kill the charger itself. It logically disables a charger… when you click disable, RMS will not route any AGVs to charge in that charging location.”

steps.title: Confirm charger status shows disabled
steps.purpose: Ensure the logical allocation control took effect before physically placing the AGV.
steps.instruction: In Charger Selection details for the selected charger, confirm the status now indicates disabled.
steps.expected_result: The selected charger status shows disabled.
steps.healthy_condition: Status is visibly disabled in the Charger Selection details panel.
steps.failure_condition: Status remains enabled after the Disable action.

actions.label: Verify disabled status
actions.exact_action: Confirm the charger allocation is now disabled in the Charger Selection details (status should indicate disabled).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the charger status does not change to disabled after clicking Disable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Disable logically disables a charger so RMS will not route AGVs to that charging location.

steps.title: Physically push/position the low-power AGV into the disabled charging station
steps.purpose: Place the low-power AGV onto the logically disabled charger so it can receive a charging boost.
steps.instruction: Physically push/position the low-power AGV into the disabled charging station (the charger remains physically present; it is logically unavailable for routing).
steps.expected_result: The low-power AGV is physically placed into the disabled charging station.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV is positioned in the charging station that is currently marked disabled in Charger Selection.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV cannot be positioned into the charging station, or it is placed into a different charger than the one disabled in RMS.

actions.label: Place AGV on disabled charger
actions.exact_action: AGV can be pushed in to the disabled charging station

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Once the charger is disable, the AGV can be pushed into the disabled charging station for manual charging/boost.

steps.title: Wait for the AGV to pick up a task and proceed via the described flow
steps.purpose: Confirm the manual charging placement resulted in the AGV resuming normal tasking.
steps.instruction: After the AGV is placed on the disabled charger, remove the AGV from the disabled charger once it has picked up a task and is going to the hospital in that tote (as described in the use case flow).
steps.expected_result: The AGV picks up a task and proceeds to the hospital in that tote; then the AGV is removed from the disabled charger.
steps.healthy_condition: You observe the AGV has transitioned to tasking (picked up a task) and is moving toward the hospital in the tote associated with the flow.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not pick up a task after being placed on the disabled charging station.

actions.label: Remove AGV after task pickup
actions.exact_action: remove the AGV from the disabled charger once it has picked up a task

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not pick up a task after being placed on the disabled charging station (the source describes that it should pick up a task and go to the hospital in that tote).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: After that’s done, you can remove the AGV. The AGV should pick up a task and go to the hospital in that tote.

steps.title: Re-enable the charging location (logical enable)
steps.purpose: Allow RMS/WCS to resume charging allocation for AGVs in the charging queue to use that charger.
steps.instruction: In Charger Selection, click Enable for that charger in the Charger Selection details panel.
steps.expected_result: The charger allocation is logically re-enabled (status changes back to enabled).
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking Enable, the selected charger status indicates enabled.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking Enable, the charger status does not return to enabled.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the charger status does not change back to enabled after clicking Enable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Then you can re enable this charging location that will allow RMS and WCS to again assigning AGVs that are in the charging queue to use that charger.

steps.title: Confirm charger status returns to enabled
steps.purpose: Verify the logical allocation control is fully restored.
steps.instruction: Confirm the selected charger’s status in Charger Selection now indicates enabled.
steps.expected_result: The selected charger status shows enabled.
steps.healthy_condition: Status is visibly enabled in Charger Selection details.
steps.failure_condition: Status remains disabled after the Enable action.

actions.label: Verify enabled status
actions.exact_action: Confirm the charger status returns to enabled in Charger Selection.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the charger status does not change back to enabled after clicking Enable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Re-enable the charging location so RMS and WCS can again assign AGVs from the charging queue to that charger.

success_criteria: The selected charger status transitions to disabled after Disable is clicked.
The selected charger status transitions back to enabled after Enable is clicked.
After placing the low-power AGV on the disabled charger, the AGV picks up a task and proceeds via the described flow (to the hospital in that tote).
healthy_conditions: Charger Selection shows the selected charger as enabled/disabled accurately.
Disabled charger is used only for the manually placed AGV (RMS will not route other AGVs to that charging location).
After re-enable, RMS/WCS can again assign AGVs from the charging queue to that charger.
failure_conditions: Charger status does not change to disabled after clicking Disable.
Charger status does not change back to enabled after clicking Enable.
AGV does not pick up a task after being placed on the disabled charging station.
escalation_guidance: If charger status does not change as expected after Disable/Enable, stop and escalate.
If the AGV does not pick up a task after being placed on the disabled charger, stop and escalate.
